title: Listening Drill — Community fridge survey
description: Project planning dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Community fridge survey
sections.transcript:
COORDINATOR: Thanks for joining this planning meeting about a community fridge. The progress report is due on Thursday. We need to agree what can be ready before then.

MEMBER: I'll start by checking the collection log. That should tell us whether the previous team has already solved part of the problem.

COORDINATOR: Good. For the trial we will use the small shelf. Send your results to Adam first, not to the whole group. I don't want unconfirmed figures copied into the report.

MEMBER: Understood. We should also remember that we have to record which days the fridge is open. I'll make a note of that in the schedule.
